title: Can't Stop Won't Stop
author: _Smoooth_Brain_
selftext:
I Started this as a fan-game borrowing many of the addicting elements of "Need For Speed Most Wanted" in the heat/cops/collision fun and decided to cook on the music for a bit only to discover how similar the extreme chases felt when they began to crash all around me like they were paid to while being vicious like NFSMW 2005 cops always did!

this chase was inspired by parts of this these scenes: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8VFIPCpocLk](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8VFIPCpocLk)

on top of it being a blast to playtest, it's been fun learning to vibe-code while doing it!

comments.author: _Smoooth_Brain_
comments.body: Lmk if you guys think this would be a potentially fun multi-player game with multiple chases, cuz CHAOS 👌
